quote: The operator of a bus, other than a tour bus, shall: Not stop such vehicle upon any street at any place for the purpose of loading or unloading passengers or their baggage other than at a bus stop, bus stand, passenger loading zone or the origin or destination point for the route to which such vehicle is assigned which has been designated in accordance with Section 11.60.010 [DEF-LVMC-11-60-010], except in case of an emergency.

activation.condition: Covered operator of a non-tour bus stops on a street for the purpose of loading or unloading passengers or their baggage.

exceptions.description: Tour bus excluded from this paragraph.

exceptions.source_clause: except in case of an emergency

exceptions.description: Officially permitted stop, stand, passenger loading zone or designated assigned-route origin/destination.
exceptions.source_clause: other than at a bus stop, bus stand, passenger loading zone or the origin or destination point

obligation.description: Do not make such a loading stop except at a bus stop, bus stand, passenger loading zone or designated assigned-route origin/destination.

timing.description: Evaluate independently reviewed stop interval, loading purpose and bus footprint, not one frame.
